answer: Proof of Burn resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to anchor its public key in a provably unspendable burn transaction. Peers verify the chain inclusion proof before routing bids, stopping free clones from flooding queues when demand hits its zenith. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of permanently destroyed capital per identity, building trust on solid timber rather than disposable keys. Yet wealthy adversaries can still purchase tokens to fund multiple accounts.
